notes: Park / T-US 2009 logistic-regression coefficient manifest. Three sets: park_2009_original (sourced from published paper), park_cosmos_validation (external validation refit), park_cohort_refit (this-cohort held-out GLM). NULL-default policy: when a primitive feature (composition, echogenicity, etc.) is NULL for a nodule, the corresponding binary X variable defaults to FALSE (absence-of-finding treated as negative). This is documented in the Phase B.6 README and the qc_phase_b6_park_x_completeness_v1 table.

park_2009_original.source: Park JY, Lee HJ, Jang HW, Kim HK, Yi JH, Lee W, Kim SH. A proposal for a thyroid imaging reporting and data system for ultrasound features of thyroid carcinoma. Thyroid. 2009;19(11):1257-64. doi:10.1089/thy.2008.0021
park_2009_original.source_access_path: Coefficients tabulated from secondary literature; original paper paywalled at Mary Ann Liebert publisher. Values reproduced from the multivariate logistic regression in Table 3 of the original paper as cited consistently across radiology references and citing publications.
park_2009_original.cohort_description: Korean single-center cohort of patients with thyroid nodules undergoing ultrasound-guided FNA; malignancy confirmed by cytology/histopathology
notes: X8 (homogeneous echotexture) coefficient is +0.648 in the published model. This is counter-intuitive vs modern TIRADS systems where homogeneity is generally treated as a benign signal. Park 2009 reported it as cohort-specific. Faithful reproduction uses the published value; downstream interpretation should note this directional flag.

Coefficients sourced from secondary literature; original paper PDF was not directly accessed for this manifest. If a discrepancy is later identified against the primary source, raise a Verification Check and bump manifest to v2.
Performance reported in the original paper: r=0.491, p<0.001 between TUS category and cytological/histological outcomes.

park_cosmos_validation.source_access_path: No qualifying external-validation refit identified during Phase B.6 closure on 2026-05-07. Aliasing to park_2009_original to preserve the three-column schema and downstream consumer compatibility. If a peer-reviewed external validation refit is later identified (e.g., a Korean or Western cohort that re-fits Park's structure on their own data), bump manifest to v2 and replace this block.
notes: The cosmos column is intentionally identical to the original column at v1. This makes the per-set comparison work against cohort-refit only; original-vs-cosmos always agrees by construction. Do not interpret high original-vs-cosmos concordance as a meaningful validation signal.

park_cohort_refit.source: This cohort (thyroid-canonical-pub-2026), 70/30 train/holdout, random_state=42, sklearn LogisticRegression(penalty='l2', C=1.0, solver='lbfgs', max_iter=1000). Train n=9975, test n=4275. Train AUC=0.7044, Test AUC=0.6914. Linkage v2 (nodule-level laterality-aware). Supersedes v1 patient-level (which produced Test AUC=0.6611).
park_cohort_refit.source_note: Populated by 417b_park_cohort_refit.py after park_2009_original coefficients are filled. Trains on nodules with all 12 X non-null AND final-pathology label within ±90d of US exam.
park_cohort_refit.linkage_strategy: nodule-level via laterality-aware per-side match in pub_workspace.us_nodule_path_outcome_v1 (Phase B.6 v2). Per-laterality malignancy match within -90/+365d of US exam, with contralateral-only-malignancy treated as benign for the unaffected side. Bilateral malignancy applies to all real-side nodules.
